    # A uniform separator row/column divides the picture into tiles.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(n, separators):

        return [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(bounds, bounds[1:]) if b > a + 1]

    col_spans = spans(w, sep_cols)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) >= 2 else 3
